text.to: S02E09 The Dirt Under Your Nails

body.summary: Animated series set in the twin cities of Piltover, the wealthy surface city, and Zaun, the poisoned undercity beneath it. Two orphaned sisters, Vi and Powder, are separated when a rescue attempt goes wrong and Powder is taken in by the crime lord Silco, who raises her into the explosives-obsessed Jinx. Meanwhile inventors Jayce and Viktor harness a magical crystal into Hextech, and Jayce rises to the Council while Viktor turns to Shimmer and a self-evolving Hexcore to survive his illness. The second season follows the war between the cities, Jinx's bond with a mute child named Isha, Ambessa Medarda's Noxian takeover of Piltover, and Viktor's Glorious Evolution, ending with ||Jayce and Viktor vanishing together, Jinx apparently sacrificing herself to save Vi, and Vi settling into life with Caitlyn||.

arcs.summary: Vi leads a rooftop heist that ends in an explosion; Vander takes the blame, Silco captures him, and Powder's rescue attempt kills Mylo and Claggor and Vander, after which Vi abandons her and Silco takes her in.
arcs.locator: S01E01 Welcome to the Playground to S01E03 The Base Violence Necessary for Change

arcs.summary: Jayce and Viktor develop Hextech, Jayce is tried and elevated to the Council, and Viktor's illness drives him to the Hexcore and Shimmer.
arcs.locator: S01E02 Some Mysteries Are Better Left Unsolved to S01E09 The Monster You Created

arcs.summary: Vi and Caitlyn travel the undercity, confront Silco, and Jinx stages a dinner where she must choose between Vi and Silco, killing Silco and firing on the Council.
arcs.locator: S01E05 Everybody Wants to Be My Enemy to S01E09 The Monster You Created

arcs.summary: After the Council bombing, Caitlyn leads a strike team into Zaun under Ambessa's influence, and Jinx bonds with Isha while Sevika tries to rally the undercity.
arcs.locator: S02E01 Heavy Is the Crown to S02E06 The Message Hidden Within the Pattern

arcs.summary: Ekko is thrown into an alternate timeline where Vi is dead and Powder is alive and happy, and builds a device to return home.
arcs.locator: S02E07 Pretend Like Its the First Time

arcs.summary: Ambessa and Viktor besiege the Hexgates; Jayce talks Viktor down, Jinx sacrifices herself to save Vi, and the cities begin to rebuild.
arcs.locator: S02E08 Killing Is a Cycle to S02E09 The Dirt Under Your Nails

notable_scenes.summary: Powder's monkey bomb detonates in the cannery, killing Mylo and Claggor, and Vi calls her a jinx before walking away.
notable_scenes.locator: S01E03 The Base Violence Necessary for Change

notable_scenes.summary: Jinx sets off explosions at the Progress Day fair and steals the Gemstone.
Jinx ties up Vi, Caitlyn and Silco at a dinner table and forces Vi to choose, then shoots Silco.
Jinx fights Vi and Caitlyn in the ventilation shafts and releases the Grey.
notable_scenes.locator: S02E03 Finally Got the Name Right

notable_scenes.locator: S02E07 Pretend Like Its the First Time

notable_scenes.summary: Jayce and Viktor reconcile and vanish together in the Hexgate core.
